id.description: Pass this as start-pipeline.teamId. Only ids with status 'ready' take effect.

kind.description: book_template = distilled from one book (reproduces its bones and voice); author_advisor = distilled across an author's works (their method, not one book's structure).

source.description: Book title for book_template, author name for author_advisor.

books.description: User-declared book groups. Grouping is declared, never inferred.

ipDnaRunId.description: Run key of the IP DNA extraction behind this book, when it has been distilled.

authorMaterials.description: Author's own material (interviews, craft notes) uploaded by the user; author_advisor only.

useEncyclopedia.description: Whether the author's public record is retrieved for distillation (the encyclopedia seat).

status.description: draft = material registered, not distilled; distilling = running; ready = usable; failed = see errorMessage.

profile.description: Distillation output; present only when status is 'ready'.

stageSkills.description: Seat id → the skill text injected into that seat's prompt.
